alert: Latency p95 above threshold on frontend

root_cause.summary: The cart service cannot connect to its Redis (valkey-cart) cache, raising FailedPrecondition errors. These errors surface in quote and checkout flows, inflating overall request latency observed at the frontend.

evidence.exception:
Status(StatusCode="FailedPrecondition", Detail="Can't access cart storage. System.ApplicationException: Wasn't able to connect to redis
   at cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected() in /usr/src/app/src/cartstore/ValkeyCartStore.cs:line 103
   at cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore.EmptyCart
evidence.why_it_matters: Deepest failing span is cart POST /EmptyCart with connection error to Redis.

evidence.exception:

evidence.why_it_matters: Repeated same failure in another trace, confirming cart issue.

evidence.message: Wasn't able to connect to redis
evidence.why_it_matters: Cart logs error 'Wasn't able to connect to redis' matching trace failures.

proposed_action.reason: Cart service is failing to connect to its Redis cache, causing errors and high latency upstream.

timeline.event: Earliest cited log line from cart
Alert received: Latency p95 above threshold on frontend

prevention: Add health checks and circuit breaker for Redis connection in cart service to avoid propagating failures.
